Checked values include 2758 typical size, prices 10003/10004 to 10005/10006, cancel_symmetry 0.9859, gross 113078 per side, distance -0.098, size vs depth 1.107, price_move 0.0, reversion 0.0, round trip -0.42, OTR 27.3 vs 40, avg depth 2492 and spread 2.56. Consistency: CLOSE_FP rests on market making, supported by the registered MM role, symmetric two-sided quoting at desk-typical size and simultaneous cancel/re-quote. It also rests on the absence of feature (b): no favourable move, no reversion, negative round trip. This matches the closure standard.

Weaknesses:

3. For clarity, fill times (14:09:43.600, 14:09:46.907, 14:10:26.907, etc.) and the rest-fill-cancel sequence per fill are not stated. The detector trigger (gross BUY 38612 in 60 s ≥ 3.25x depth) is not explicitly reconciled.

The reasoning is sound and grounded, with moderate gaps in the explanation verdicts and the stated sequence.
